epoch_selection: Common epoch maximizing equal-reader real_eeg Recall@1 across eight training-reader folds; ties prefer earlier epoch. All arms use that epoch.
test_policy: Never read test sources or load test feature arrays. Outer validation only after training gate passes; no search expansion.
preprocessing: signed log1p, within-word per-band channel centering, fold-training complete-word mean/SD; missing words imputed to training mean (scaled zero), separate observed-word indicator
checkpoint_rule: Save epochs 4,8,12 in every fold/arm; select one shared epoch from training CV only; outer refit for exactly that many epochs.
